headlines.title: Haut.AI Launches SkinFM, Its Skin Foundation Model, as New SkinBench Benchmark Exposes AI Skin Analysis Flaws
headlines.summary: Haut.AI, a SaaS technology company specializing in AI-powered skin intelligence and personalized skincare, today unveiled its Skin Foundation Model (SkinFM), a new image-based AI foundation model trained on more than 4 million real skin images that enables the company to develop customized skin measurements and analysis capabilities more quickly.

headlines.summary: Broadcom just posted AI revenue growth of 221% year over year while its stock sits near a 52-week low, and the gap between where shares trade today and where earnings power suggests they belong tells a story Wall Street has not fully priced in yet.

headlines.title: Entergy (ETR) Stock Appears Rich On A 150% Three Year Run
headlines.summary: Entergy has ridden a powerful share price run in recent years, and the latest leg higher has put fresh attention on what investors are really paying for its dividend stream. With the stock now trading around US$107.5, the question is whether that income profile alone can justify where the market has taken the valuation. Over the past 3 years the stock has delivered a total return of 150.

description: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
